column3: The Hebrew uses “serve” where BSB has “worship.”
The Hebrew names “your house” rather than “your palace.”
The Hebrew has a collective singular, “the frog.”
The Hebrew says to “cut off” the frogs where BSB has “be taken away.”
The Hebrew says they piled them “heaps, heaps,” and simply says the land stank.
The Hebrew says Pharaoh made his heart “heavy.”
The Hebrew describes the heart as becoming strong rather than explicitly passive hardening.
The Hebrew uses “serve” where BSB has “worship.”
The Hebrew names “the swarm,” without explicitly identifying flies.
The Hebrew uses the word “redemption” where BSB has “distinction.”
The Hebrew says “Pharaoh’s house” and calls the swarm “heavy.”
